commercial_terms.m1_due: before customer file exchange; after NDA and SOW signing

customer: control the supplied GGUF and have authority to provide it for the engagement
provide a runnable evaluation harness and frozen evaluation-suite identity
provide a public HTTPS contact surface for non-confidential routing only
review the SOW and NDA through an owner-private channel
review AT1-AT6 evidence and make the acceptance decision
tjlabs: record the original GGUF SHA-256 before modification
perform only the bounded diagnostic intervention in the signed SOW
produce baseline, ablation and restore harness receipts
restore byte-exact identity or stop and report HOLD
deliver a concise finding, limitations and artifact-hash receipt
avoid public release of customer model bytes, private method-leaking binary diffs and credentials

days.required_exit: NDA/SOW/M1 evidence receipts + GGUF control + harness readiness; otherwise HOLD before file transfer
AT1 original hash/size + frozen harness command/eval-suite identities
baseline harness receipt and reproducibility notes
bounded intervention plan inside signed scope; no metric guarantee
AT2 distinct artifact hash + ablation harness receipt
customer-evaluable evidence linked to frozen harness; no public model bytes
AT3 restored SHA-256 and byte count exactly equal AT1
AT5 concise report receipt + explicit limitations
AT6 delivery receipt names required hashes; customer acceptance remains external

hard_stops.when: customer cannot attest legal/control authority for the GGUF
customer harness is unavailable or cannot be frozen reproducibly
owner-private NDA, SOW or M1 evidence is absent
requested work exceeds the bounded intervention in the signed SOW
restored SHA-256 or byte count differs from the original
delivery would require public original/ablated/restored binaries or a method-leaking binary diff
customer requests credential transfer through Commons
acceptance is conditioned on guaranteed metric lift instead of AT1-AT6 rollback evidence

allowed_in_commons: public HTTPS contact URL without query or fragment

expansion.condition: only after real customer AT1-AT6 acceptance on the same GGUF
expansion.license_condition: only after paid delivery; never inferred from diagnostic completion
